subject: Secure review packets & manager delivery plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Carla Ruiz <carla@eastbridge.consulting>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Secure review packet and delivery plan

Team —

As we discussed in last week's leadership sync, this year's annual review cycle needs an added privacy envelope for sensitive roles and a manager-delivery workflow that prevents bulk access to confidential scores. I sketched a lightweight operational plan and attached a manager packet (PDF) plus the redaction guidelines we agreed were necessary. High-level asks: 

- Confirm we can run the sealed packet process for ~45 privileged hires (list to follow).
- Ops: can we provision time-limited download links via SecureForms for manager packets (48h TTL, single-access)?
- Legal/Compliance: need an audit log export for every packet access event (timestamp, accessor, IP).
- Communications: I'll draft manager and IC comms once the delivery cadence is set.

Attachments: 2026-manager-packet-sealed.pdf (draft), redaction-guidelines-2026.docx

I copied Carla from Eastbridge — they're standing by to help set up the encrypted delivery if we want a vendor flow. Propose a 2-stage delivery: managers receive sealed packet + acknowledgment DocuSign, then limited HR sees full packet on escalation only.

Will take ownership on the comm draft; looking for quick thumbs-up on the ops constraints by EOD Friday.

—Ben Carter
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Carla Ruiz <carla@eastbridge.consulting>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Secure review packet and delivery plan

Ben — thanks for the outline. A few operational clarifications from my side: 

1) Manager delivery cadence: recommend two waves to reduce support load — Wave A (managers of sensitive roles) on Mar 18, Wave B (rest of managers) on Mar 25.
2) Packet contents: managers get a sealed packet with summary + performance evidence. Full notes remain in HR view only unless manager requests escalation (tracked).
3) Secure access: SecureForms TTL=48h single-access works; can we also add a short phone verification step for those with exec-level access?
4) Acknowledgment: DocuSign signature required that confirms manager reviewed but did not share. We should record the signature hash in the audit log.

I've annotated the attached redaction doc with a few examples (see page 3). If we get vendor support for the delivery API, I can run two test packets next week.

- Monica
Sr. People Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Carla Ruiz <carla@eastbridge.consulting>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: SecureForms Support <support@secureforms.io>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Secure review packet and delivery plan

Ben / Monica —

Thanks for the brief. We can implement a sealed packet workflow that meets your constraints. Quick notes on approach and tradeoffs: 

- Implementation: we wrap the packet in an envelope encrypted at rest and deliver a single-use URL that does client-side decryption. That supports 48h TTL + single-use semantics.
- Audit logs: we can stream access events to your SIEM in near-real time (CloudWatch/Splunk). Events include accessor email, timestamp, source IP, and browser fingerprint.
- Phone verification: we can add an SMS OTP step for exec-level managers; extra latency ~15–30s.
- Redaction: we recommend canonical redaction templates for manager-facing summaries; full notes locked under HR view.

Next step: if you confirm Wave A/B dates and provide the initial manager list, we will schedule a 1-hr integration test on Feb 24. 

Attachment: integration-checklist (we'll send a vendor PDF when we stand up the sandbox).

—Carla Ruiz
Director, People Ops Advisory — Eastbridge Consulting

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Carla Ruiz <carla@eastbridge.consulting>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Secure review packet and delivery plan — legal/audit asks

All — quick update after a call with Legal and Security: 

- Legal wants a per-packet immutable audit export (NDJSON) that we can attach to each closed review record; they also asked for retention policy (suggest 7 years for exec-level, 3 years for others).
- Security: require that vendor keys are rotated monthly and that HSM-backed encryption is used for envelope keys. We need vendor SOC2 evidence before production roll.
- Compliance: any DocuSign template must include a cryptographic signature hash in the packet metadata and a link to the DocuSign envelope.

Operational asks for Monica/Ben: please confirm final manager lists by Feb 23. Also confirm whether Wave A should include a short walkthrough (15m) the morning of Mar 18 — Security prefers we do the walkthrough to avoid helpdesk calls.

—Vivek Kulkarni
VP, People & Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Secure review packet and delivery plan — manager comms draft

Team —

Thanks for the rapid feedback. Based on vendor confirmation and Legal/Security asks, here's the final manager comm and next steps (please review inline):

Manager comm (to be sent the morning of assigned wave):

Subject: Your sealed manager packet for the 2026 performance cycle — action required

Hi {Manager Name},

Your manager packet for the 2026 performance cycle will be available on {date/time}. This packet is delivered in a sealed, single-use envelope. Important details: 

- You will receive a single-use secure link (48 hours) — the link can only be opened once.
- Exec-level managers will see a short phone verification step to confirm identity.
- After opening, you must complete a short acknowledgment via DocuSign (link in the packet). We retain the DocuSign signature hash as part of the audit record.
- If you require additional context beyond the redacted manager summary, open a request with HR and include the reference code. HR will evaluate and escalate where appropriate.

Next steps: 
- Monica: finalize Wave A/B manager lists and send by Feb 23 (ACTION).
- Carla/SecureForms: provision sandbox links and share integration checklist (ACTION).
- Vivek: confirm retention windows for exec vs. non-exec (ACTION).
- Laura: draft a short FAQ for managers and a one-paragraph IC comm (ACTION).

I'll send the manager comm through the platform once the Wave A list is confirmed. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll consider this approved and begin scheduling the vendor test.

Attachments referenced: 2026-manager-packet-sealed.pdf, redaction-guidelines-2026.docx

—Ben Carter
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference
